title: The Fallen King
description:
Name: [Malkuth](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/photos/malkuth.png:150:150)
Known Locations: Oceans
Estimated Size: Large
Behavior: Utilizes fire and ice elements and puts his opponent on equal footing, making them immune to one and weak to the other, shown through a circle on their crosshair. Strikes powerful attacks with swords, the elements, and cannons. Because of equal footing, he cannot be damaged by means other than the cannons in the arena.
Danger Level: §8§lDeadly
